t: 英国人詹姆斯·奥格尔索普通过在萨凡纳定居,发现了13个殖民地的第13个殖民地佐治亚.
te: Englishman James Oglethorpe founds Georgia, the 13th colony of the Thirteen Colonies, by settling at Savannah.
dz: 佐治亚日:英国人詹姆斯·奥格尔索普通过在萨凡纳定居,发现了13个殖民地的第13个殖民地佐治亚.
de: Georgia Day: Englishman James Oglethorpe founds Georgia, the 13th colony of the Thirteen Colonies, by settling at Savannah.

t: 新法兰西定居者奴役原住民的权利在魁北克市得到维护.
te: The right of settlers in New France to enslave natives is upheld at Quebec City.
dz: 新法兰西定居者奴役原住民的权利在魁北克市得到维护.
de: The right of settlers in New France to enslave natives is upheld at Quebec City.

t: 奥斯曼军队在巴格达战役中击败了Nader Shah手下的伊朗军队.
te: The Ottoman army defeats the Iranian army under Nader Shah in the battle of Baghdad.
dz: 奥斯曼军队在巴格达战役中击败了Nader Shah手下的伊朗军队.
de: The Ottoman army defeats the Iranian army under Nader Shah in the battle of Baghdad.

t: 未来美国的第一个梅森克大酒店由马萨诸塞州所组成.
te: The first Masonic Grand Lodge in the future United States is constituted in Massachusetts.
dz: 未来美国的第一个梅森克大酒店由马萨诸塞州所组成.
de: The first Masonic Grand Lodge in the future United States is constituted in Massachusetts.

t: 1733年奴隶起义的开始 在当时的丹麦西印度群岛上.
te: The start of the 1733 slave insurrection on St. John in what was then the Danish West Indies.
dz: 1733年奴隶起义的开始 在当时的丹麦西印度群岛上.
